name: Kiss the Demiurge
source:
[i]"For the purification of humanity!"[/i]

Kiss the Demiurge is a dark comedy yuri visual novel about magic, delusions, regret, and love. 

It follows the story of a girl named Minori, the mage who absolutely hates magic. As a child, she wished to become a magical girl like the heroes she saw on TV. One day, a mysterious voice offered to grant her magic powers and make her dreams come true. The young Minori eagerly accepted the stranger's gift, and was absolutely delighted as magic powers were bestowed upon her. But unfortunately for her, she soon came to realise that the gift of magic was actually a curse, a force of nature far beyond her control. Minori's magic misfired and both of her parents disappeared from this world because of it. She grew up wracked with guilt and declared that she would atone for her sins by ridding the world of all those who would seek magic.

Minori investigates a fire at a local high school that she suspects to have been caused by magic. There, she just so happens to spy a poster advertising a magic club, dedicated to "Studying and spreading magic across the world."
The very concept of the club angers her and she immediately sets off to infiltrate and stamp out the members magical ambitions.

[Edited fom [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098600/Kiss_the_Demiurge/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]“为了净化人类！”[/i]

《亲吻造物主》是一部黑色幽默风格的百合视觉小说，讲述魔法、妄想、悔恨与爱情。

故事围绕名叫Minori的女孩展开。她是一位极度厌恶魔法的法师。小时候，她梦想成为电视英雄那样的魔法少女。一天，一个神秘声音提出赋予她魔力、实现她的梦想。年幼的Minori欣然接受了陌生人的馈赠，在获得魔力后欣喜不已。然而，她很快发现这份礼物其实是一种诅咒，是远超她掌控能力的自然之力。Minori的魔法失控，导致她的双亲从这个世界消失。她深受愧疚折磨，并宣称自己会铲除所有追求魔法之人，以此赎罪。

Minori调查当地一所高中的火灾，怀疑是魔法所致。她恰好看到一张魔法社的海报，上面写着“在全世界研究并传播魔法”。
社团的理念令她怒不可遏，于是她立刻动身潜入社团，铲除成员们对魔法的追求。

[据[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098600/Kiss_the_Demiurge/]Steam[/url]内容编译]
